LanguageData.SocSetts.Addons.title: Addons
LanguageData.SocSetts.AcceleratingParticles.label: Accelerating Particles
LanguageData.SocSetts.AcceleratingParticles.desc:
Adds new content including ion thrusters, anti‑thrusters, and antiproton capsules.
- Ion Thruster: Requires no fuel, consumes 120 W of energy when active, providing thrust of 600 kN. - Anti‑Thruster: “Provides a thrust of 4200 kN, but has a small tank and high antiproton consumption.
The setting does not fully disable the content; it simply removes thrusters from the construction menu and antiproton from the crafting menu.
Applied after restart.
LanguageData.SocSetts.Ships.title: Ships
LanguageData.SocSetts.StarSectorShips.label: StarSector
LanguageData.SocSetts.StarSectorShips.desc: A collection of ships in the style of the StarSector game. Includes several destroyers and frigates with a combat rating of 1000, and other types of ships - fighters, bombers, cargo ships, shuttles.\n\n- Ships have been reworked, the original version was created by Antisodium.
LanguageData.SocSetts.X4FoundationsShips.label: X4 Foundations
LanguageData.SocSetts.X4FoundationsShips.desc: A collection of ships in the style of the X4 Foundations game. Includes several large ships with a combat rating of 2000, like the Asgard cruiser, and other ship classes - fighters, frigates, cargo ships, destroyers.
LanguageData.SocSetts.DifferentShips.label: Various Ships
LanguageData.SocSetts.DifferentShips.desc: A collection of various ships and structures that do not fall into other categories. May contain stations, mini-ships, fighters, cargo ships, frigates, destroyers, and cruisers.
LanguageData.SocSetts.Patches.Title: Patches
LanguageData.SocSetts.LifeSupportEnergy.label: Energy Patch
LanguageData.SocSetts.LifeSupportEnergy.desc: Reduces the energy consumption of the life support system by 2x, and the small life support system by 3x.\n\nApplied after restart.
LanguageData.SocSetts.OdysseyHullGraphics.label: Odyssey Hull Graphics
LanguageData.SocSetts.OdysseyHullGraphics.desc: Ship hull graphics from the Odyssey add-on.\n\nApplied after restart.
LanguageData.SocSetts.OdysseyThrustersGraphics.label: Odyssey Thrusters Graphics
LanguageData.SocSetts.OdysseyThrustersGraphics.desc: Ship thruster graphics from the Odyssey add-on.\n\nApplied after restart.
LanguageData.SocSetts.RCSLayerFix.label: RCS Layer Fix
LanguageData.SocSetts.RCSLayerFix.desc: Sets the RCS thruster render layer to FloorEmplacement so it displays correctly.\n\nApplied after restart.
LanguageData.SocSetts.RussianTranslation.label: Translation Patch
LanguageData.SocSetts.RussianTranslation.desc: Replaces the text "Hover Mode" with "Режим парения" in the shuttle interface. Apply if want to learn some Russian words.\n\nApplied after restart.
